Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
When using Ohoyo's ability, does the blocking minion lock or does it stay unlocked ?

Considering the timing and  [ANK 20190528] , I'd say the original blocker does not lock.

On the the other hand, Ohoyo's ability only cancels the combat and replaces it with another one - it says nothing about cancelling the block or thwarting the block resolution. So, which is it ?

Ohoyo Hopoksia (Bastet)

[Ahrimane]
Unique werewolf with 3 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.

When a minion you control is about to enter combat with an acting minion, you may lock Ohoyo to cancel that combat; Ohoyo enters combat with the acting minion instead. She gets an optional maneuver each combat. If she has less than 3 life during your unlock phase, she gains 1 life from the blood bank.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The blocking minion is locked.
groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/Rc8cvYcuniM/vB4K6QxFNWEJ

Ohoyo Hopoksia's effet is a replacement effect on the combat part only. It doesn't end the action before the block resolution, it changes a part of it.

"is about to" should be "would".

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
